The massive '''Gamorrean wargloves''' were created by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] race to provide considerable protection. However, these gauntlets were quite inflexible reducing accuracy with all but the heaviest weapons, such as bulky axes. While equipped, the wargloves would give the wearer additional strength.
